result.summary: Found 2 visual issues: one truncated text and one partially cut-off card element.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol...' in the 'Fastest near you' section is truncated and cut off at the right edge of the screen, making it unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the last visible card in a horizontal scroll list either shows a clear partial preview to hint at scrollability, or the restaurant name is not clipped — use ellipsis text overflow or adjust card width to always show the full name within its container.

issues.description: The bottom pizza restaurant card is partially cut off vertically at the bottom of the screen with no visual indicator (like a partial image fade or scroll hint) to suggest more content is available below.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle gradient fade or ensure the partial card is intentionally cropped enough to clearly communicate scrollability to the user.
